purpose: Seed for EP02 SC41 after EP02 SC40 formal test-mode segment. Continue the ComfyUI short-drama pipeline from the point where truth is nearly bare and the white-clothed woman's restraint is nearly cracking into the next threshold: Keshadu's conclusion is almost openly visible, Shisilang's fury is at the lip of rupture, Tuobaye is nearly fully exhausted, and the white-clothed woman's still pressure is on the edge of visible fracture.
title: 真相将显形，静压将崩裂

continuity_from.approval_mode: Codex auto-pass test mode with user authorization
continuity_from.caveat: SC40 is approved only for pipeline validation. All four SC40 videos used Comfy StillFrameVideoFallback because stable reference-driven I2V is not currently available through Gemini and Runway secret is missing.

source_grounding.anchor_after: 真相将外露，十四郎怒线将断，拓拔野几近空尽，白衣女子的静压已到将裂开边缘。
source_grounding.adapted_summary: 下一段要把这条线继续推进到真正外显崩裂前的门槛。科沙度的判断几乎显形，十四郎的怒势也只差一步就会失控，拓拔野几乎彻底空尽，而白衣女子的静压来到马上要崩裂的边缘。
source_grounding.next_source_hint: 下一段应把隐线从将外露与将裂开推进到真正外显断裂前的门槛，为明确出手、揭露或局面失控做直接引爆。
